messages:
alice.m: Quick handoff — noticed a capacity drift in eu-west gpu pool during the last hour. not an incident but queue length for batch-infer grew from <10 to ~40 for a few mins. likely due to a set of nightly eval jobs kicking off. checking now :eyes:

ben.k: thanks for flagging. any customers impacted?

alice.m: no 5xx or latency SLO breaches. just queueing increase and a couple of short spike throttles. policy allowed burst satisfied but headroom dropped to ~12% on one shard.

carlos.g: pinging CI infra — we're running a big regression eval that's supposed to be on preemptible. looks like some moved to dedicated accidentally. investigating.

diane: fyi marketing has a demo run scheduled for eu-west tomorrow at 09:00 UTC — could cause small sustained load if they replay.

alice.m: noted. actions I'm taking before handing off:
- bumped autoscale min for eu-west-gpu-pool by +1 for next 2 hours
- set temporary alert: queue_length > 30 for 5m -> page oncall (silent until I handoff)
- leaving a small runbook note in the runbook channel

Command I ran:
```
rctl pools set-scale eu-west-gpu-pool --min 3 --ttl 2hctl pools watch eu-west-gpu-pool --json | jq '.shards[] | {id,utilization,queue_len}'
```

ben.k: :thumbsup: can you drop the output snippet? useful for followup.

alice.m: output pasted below:
```
["shard-4", "util": 0.78, "queue": 38]
["shard-5", "util": 0.62, "queue": 4]
["shard-6", "util": 0.11, "queue": 0]
```

carlos.g: thanks — looks like shard-4 handled most of the load. I'll reassign a few jobs back to preemptible tags and restart the reg-eval controller. should free up headroom in ~6-8m.

diane: for handoff — I'm available to cover 02:00-08:00 UTC if you need me to watch for the demo burst prep later.

alice.m: appreciate it. if you can watch 02-06 UTC that covers overlap with the flip to stable configs. leaving the temporary alert to page the oncall if queue >30 after 02:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: NOTE: temporary alert created by alice.m -> queue_length>30 (eu-west-gpu-pool). Pages: primary-oncall. Expires in 2h.

ben.k: small checklist for next oncall to pick up:
- confirm rctl pools show reports min=3 for eu-west
- watch dashboard: /dash/infra/eu-west/pools (last 15m)
- if queue persists >30 after 15m, escalate to eng-runtime and consider manual shard swap: `rctl pools swap-shard shard-4 shard-6`
- check for any unexpected dedicated tags on CI jobs (carlos is on it)

carlos.g: reg-eval restarted, deduped the dedicated tag, queue dropped to ~6. will keep an eye and post if anything else.

diane: I'll cover 02-06 UTC. if the demo traffic lands we should consider pre-warming one extra shard for 09-10 UTC and set a short policy to revert.

alice.m: perfect. handoff complete from my side. leave the temporary alert enabled until 02:00 UTC, then Diane will decide whether to extend. leaving a short note in #runbook: "eu-west drift — shard-4 hotspot — preemptible tag regression"

ben.k: thanks everyone. small FYI: I'll follow up in the morning with a short postmortem of the tagging bug in CI so we don't regress.

oncall-bot: handoff recorded: from alice.m to diane at 1851240000.

diane: got it, thanks. :checkered_flag:

alice.m: signing off, ping me if anything surprises you.
